findings.description: The KMS customer master key does not have automatic rotation enabled (enable_key_rotation is not set, which defaults to false). Without rotation, the key has an indefinitely long cryptographic lifetime, increasing the risk of key compromise and violating key-hygiene best practices for data at rest encryption.

The KMS key is created without an explicit key policy, so the default key policy applies, which grants the account root principal broad administrative permissions and leaves the effective access control to the surrounding account/role configuration. This can permit overly broad use and management of the key by any principal with key grants.
